text:
maria: Quick sync on Private deploy roadmap 9 Q3 goals: make upgrades predictable and reduce installer surface area. Field pressure for clearer VPC/peering presets and safer rollouts.
oliver: I suggest splitting into three smaller projects: 1) installer slimming (packs + optional modules), 2) routing presets (3 profiles), 3) upgrade safety (canary + rollback tooling).
priya: Field specifically asked for an "ip-preserve mode" for tenant migrations and a no-internet install path. The slimmer installer must support offline KMS blobs.
release-bot: Notice: nightly acceptance for private-upgrade-tests flaked 1/5. Failing step: upgrade-smoke -> db-migration-check. Logs: ```ERR: tenant-cidr-mismatch during migration validation```
sam: For upgrade safety: we need these hard checks before proceeding - preflight, dry-run validation, and a reversible DB migration strategy (backwards-compatible schema). Also require a 15-min automatic pause window on failure.
tanya: Routing presets idea (three): "peer-basic" (static NAT), "netops-bgp" (BGP session + route-maps), "relay-nat64" (for strict NAT/masq). Each preset should include an ops doc and terraform example.
maria: Security: any shim/agent must honor customer KMS and generate audit events for upgrade approval/rollback. Also require signed bundles for offline installs.
ursula: Priorities: installer slim is fastest win, routing presets medium, upgrade tooling highest impact but largest effort. Recommend ship order: slim -> presets -> upgrade tooling core features.
oliver: Can we short-circuit by delivering a "migration assistant" CLI that maps and validates CIDRs to reduce field effort? Small, high-impact.
priya: Yes, migration assistant sounds good. Also need a clear rollback SLA we can promise customers. Propose 48-72 hour rollback window for critical upgrades.
sam: I'll draft the preflight checklist WIP: ```- kernel >=4.15 or container runtime with userns
- disk >= 30GB
- certs present / signed bundle verification
- tenant CIDR overlap check
- iptables/nft compatibility```
maria: Owners: Installer slim -> Maria (PM) + Priya (infra). Routing presets -> Oliver (PM) + Tanya (netops). Upgrade safety -> Sam (release) + Ursula (platform).
release-bot: Created issue PRIV-2024-upgrade-safety and linked to thread 1759999999.
priya: Next steps: Priya will prototype an offline-signed-bundle flow by Friday; Oliver will sketch preset terraform snippets; Sam will prototype canary toggles. Ping this thread with blockers.
maria: Great. I'll schedule a 30min sync Friday to review prototypes. Thanks all. :rocket:
